messages.subject: Vantage Freight - my witness statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Not about the Whitcombe matter - separately, on the Vantage Freight claim, I've marked up the draft witness statement you sent about the termination of the logistics services agreement. A couple of the dates in paragraph 9 need correcting (the December peak figures were 2024, not 2023). I'll bring the hard copy when I'm down in London.

Also, is there any update on the trial window? Gordon asked.

Mark Tennant
Operations Manager
Sutherland Logistics Limited
